name: Nanaka
message: 「Things have been totally hectic since this morning, huh~」

name: Synn
message: 「The early bird really does catch the worm... hmm, or does it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You saved a girl from evil clutches, so hold your head up high!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「So, apparently, we're getting a transfer student today~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Word is they're an exchange student from a faraway foreign country~」

name: Synn
message: 「It was already multinational to begin with」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I wonder if it's a girl~? Or a boy~?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「My vote's on a boy. Sacchin, you get girl. Loser buys sweets!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whaaaat?! I feel like that's a super unfair bet~」

name: Synn
message: 「I think it's gonna be a girl」

name: Nanaka
message: 「In your case, that's just what you're hoping for」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just look around this classroom! Everywhere you look, it's girls, girls, girls! If we get any more, we're basically going back to being an all-girls school!!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not like I'm recruiting them or anything. There's no guarantee a guy will show up」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Really? Maybe I can actually win this bet then」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I said it's a boy, so it's a boy!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Sounds like Nana-chan is the one desperately wishing for a boy~」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, so that's how it is」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No! I just don't want more girls around, it's not like I want boys or anything--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grrr! You've got a lot of nerve for Synn!」

name: Helena
message: 「Now, take your seats! This isn't a warning, it's an order!」

name: Helena
message: 「I have some wonderful news for everyone. Starting today, you'll be gaining a new friend in this class!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't know... but I feel like something terrible will happen if we don't...」

True enough, this is Ms. Helena we're talking about, who doesn't usually step into the spotlight. Since she's going out of her way to pull off something this outrageous, it wouldn't even be weird to see fresh fish sold in vending machines.

name: Helena
message: 「I see. Now, come on in, Azel-chan.」
The girl called Azel simply stood there blankly, not looking at anything in particular.

name: Helena
message: 「Azel-chan is a cute exchange student who came all the way from the Principality of Sharo-Ma. Everyone, please make her feel welcome!」
She lowers her eyes and gives a slight bow, without uttering a single word.
Her eyes focus on me. It feels like she's seeing right through to my spine, and my heart skips a beat.
After saying that, she marches briskly right up to me.
Did the transfer student already single me out!? I-Is this what they call the dignity of the student council president--
Sure enough, she just sat down in the empty seat next to me.

name: Helena
message: 「Alright, dismissed. Work hard in class. I'm wishing you all the best!」
And so, without the homeroom teacher ever getting a turn to step in, Helena-san's pompous introduction of the transfer student came to a close.
I casually glance over next to me. Sitting there is a young girl without a single textbook on her desk, just as you'd expect from a transfer student.
Still, not even taking out a notebook.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey. Could it be you're trying to save money?」
She must be feeling lost. As the student council president, it's my duty to help the transfer student.

name: Synn
message: 「Textbooks. If you don't mind mine, want to share?」
I casually lean in closer to her.
Some kind of crumpled-up piece of paper came flying at me.
When I unfold it, it says 'Pervert!' inside.
Looking back, I saw Nanaka sticking her tongue out at me. Even though Nanaka's the bigger pervert.
Completely ignoring me as I made a face like someone had eaten all the shrimp out of my chili shrimp, the girl next to me pulled a textbook out from inside her desk.

name: Synn
message: 「You do have one after all. In that case, you should make sure to take it out properly」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Wha, you don't have to say it like that」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... Still, Azel-san. At least open your textbook」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, we just met, so I thought it'd be rude not to」

name: Synn
message: 「You mean it's okay to call you without honorifics?」
C-Could this mean our relationship is suddenly taking a huge, rapid leap forward!?
